title: 第11章 被窥曝光挖他眼珠子第12章 囚禁两百多年的疯老头
lines: 云霜儿清冷的目光看向林易，眼眸深处似乎有些疑惑。
入门十多年，似乎还是第一次有人来找她，而且还是一位男弟子。
她没有说话，只是拎着她那柄白色仙剑默默的站着。
林易轻咳两声，站起来道：“云师妹，我这一次前来，是为了叶风师弟的事儿，想向师妹求证……”
云霜儿明白了。
她淡淡的道：“叶风？那个登徒子死了？”
林易目光微微一凝，随即摇头，道：“没有没有，叶风师弟今日已经回来自首，如今被关押在戒律院。”
“我已经惩治过他，剩下的就依门规处置吧，我相信玉尘子师叔会秉公执法，严惩此淫贼。”
“淫贼？”
竹舍内的三人面面相觑，一脸的问号。
玉英真人缓缓的问道：“霜儿，你认识叶风？他是不是……对你做了什么？”
云霜儿表情忽然起了一丝的变化，冷漠的眼神也有些波动。
她缓缓摇头，道：“前几天我遇到他，他言语上有些轻浮，我当时已经教训过他了。”
云霜儿并没有说实话，毕竟是姑娘，总不能大庭广众之下告诉众人，叶风偷看自已的沐浴，自已的清白身子都被那小子看光了，那样自已以后还怎么做人？
玉英真人凝视着云霜儿。
她一手将云霜儿养大，对于这个小弟子她最是了解。
此刻她看到了云霜儿眼神的细微变化，知道云霜儿并没有说实话，起码不是全部的实话。
林易开口询问道：“云师姐，你是何时遇见叶风的？他有没有对你说什么？”
云霜儿眼神再度起了细微的变化。
就像是平静的水面上被丢进了一枚很小的石子，泛起了淡淡的涟漪。
“你是在调查叶风被害之事？”
云霜儿语气平淡的询问道。
玉英真人与大弟子金禾，又是满脑子问号。
林易此次却坦然的多，云霜儿既然真的遇到过叶风，叶风肯定也告诉了她，自已是从乱坟岗里爬出来的。
所以云霜儿知晓此事，林易并不觉得奇怪。
“也不全是。”
林易缓缓摇头，道：“我目前在兽灵院帮玉衡师叔处理事务，这一次主要是调查叶风负责的甲字七号药圃药材丢失之事，其他事情，归戒律院调查，我无权插手。
叶风今日投案时，说他失忆了，什么都问不出来，他说前几日在星罗峰附近遇到过云师妹，是云师妹告诉他的身份等信息，不知可有此事？”
玉英真人感觉到了事情的不同寻常。
玉英真人道：“霜儿，到底怎么回事？”
云霜儿犹豫了片刻，才开口说道：“大概五六天前，我确实在后山遇见了叶风，当时他正被一头巨虎追逐，我便出手救了下来。
后来我才知道，他失忆了，以前的事儿什么都不记得了，甚至连自已的名字都忘记了，只记得他是从落霞峰后面的那处乱坟岗的泥土里爬出来的。
content_en:
Yun Shuang'er looked at Lin Yi with cold eyes, and there seemed to be some doubts in the depths of her eyes.
After being a disciple for more than ten years, it seemed that this was the first time someone came to her, and it was a male disciple.
She didn't speak, just stood silently holding her white fairy sword.
Lin Yi coughed twice, stood up and said: "Junior Sister Yun, I am here this time because of Junior Brother Ye Feng's matter, and I want to ask Junior Sister for confirmation..."
Yun Shuang'er understood.
She said calmly: "Ye Feng? Is that disciple dead?"
Lin Yi's eyes narrowed slightly, then he shook his head and said, "No, no, Junior Brother Ye Feng has returned and surrendered today, and is now being held in the Discipline Academy."
"I have already punished him, and the rest will be dealt with according to the sect's rules. I believe that Uncle Yuchenzi will enforce the law impartially and severely punish this lewd thief."
"A thief?"
The three people in the bamboo house looked at each other with questions on their faces.
Master Yuying asked slowly: "Shuang'er, do you know Ye Feng? Did he... do something to you?"
Yun Shuang'er's expression suddenly changed slightly, and her indifferent eyes also fluctuated a bit.
She shook her head slowly and said, "I met him a few days ago and he was a little frivolous in his words. I had already taught him a lesson."
Yun Shuang'er didn't tell the truth. She was a girl after all. She couldn't tell everyone in public that Ye Feng peeked at her bathing and her innocence was exposed by that boy. How could she behave like that in the future?
Master Yuying stared at Yun Shuang'er.
She single-handedly raised Yun Shuang'er, and she knew this little disciple best.
At this moment, she saw the subtle changes in Yun Shuang'er's eyes, and knew that Yun Shuang'er was not telling the truth, at least not the whole truth.
Lin Yi asked: "Sister Yun, when did you meet Ye Feng? Did he say anything to you?"
Yun Shuang'er's eyes changed slightly again.
It was like a small stone was thrown into the calm water, causing faint ripples.
"Are you investigating Ye Feng's murder?"
Yun Shuang'er asked in a calm tone.
Master Yuying and his eldest disciple Jin He were filled with questions again.
Lin Yi was much calmer this time. Since Yun Shuang'er had really met Ye Feng, Ye Feng must have told her that he crawled out of the graveyard.
So Lin Yi didn't find it strange that Yun Shuang'er knew about this.
"Not entirely."
Lin Yi slowly shook his head and said: "I am currently helping Uncle Yu Heng handle affairs at the Beast Spirit Academy. This time, I am mainly investigating the loss of medicinal materials in the No. 7 medicinal garden that Ye Feng is responsible for. Other matters are investigated by the Discipline Academy and I have no right to intervene.
When Ye Feng surrendered today, he said that he had lost his memory and could not ask anything. He said that he had met Junior Sister Yun near Xingluo Peak a few days ago. It was Junior Sister Yun who told him his identity and other information. I wonder if this is the case? "
Master Yuying felt that things were unusual.
Master Yuying said: "Shuang'er, what's going on?"
Yun Shuang'er hesitated for a moment before speaking: "About five or six days ago, I did meet Ye Feng in the back mountain. At that time, he was being chased by a giant tiger, and I rescued him.
Later I found out that he had lost his memory. He couldn't remember anything about the past, not even his own name. I only remembered that he crawled out of the mud of the mass grave behind Luoxia Peak.
title_en: Chapter 11: Exposed by spying and gouging out his eyes Chapter 12: The crazy old man imprisoned for more than two hundred years
